units.source_text: “是呵……”老头像在整理头脑中的旧文件，唠唠叨叨，慢条斯理地说，

en.t: “Yes, well...” the old man said slowly and ramblingly, as if sorting through old files in his head,

units.source_text: “这个嘛，未必不能商量嘛……是呵，打个比方说吧，

en.t: “As for that, it may not be completely beyond discussion... yes, let us say, for example,

units.source_text: 你们两个人，到外面来，在大伙儿的面前嘛……

en.t: the two of you come outside, in front of everyone...

units.source_text: 干一回那种事儿给大家看看，这个嘛，可以成为理由，

en.t: and do that sort of thing once for everyone to see. That could serve as a reason,

units.source_text: 在大伙儿的面前，假如行的话……”

en.t: in front of everyone, if that would do...”
